$comment: diagram-style tokens. Colours are Excalidraw open-color values, so hand edits in the Excalidraw picker match. STYLE.md explains every token; change both together.

managed.means: provider-managed, public or internet-facing, the cloud region or network the figure is about

owned.means: run by us or the customer, private or internal, healthy

focus.means: the recommended option or the thing the figure is about; at most one or two per figure

hub.means: shared hub or landing point: transit, shared services, the place connections terminate

external.means: another estate: other cloud, on-prem, DR site, third party

automation.means: identity, controllers and cross-account links (e.g. external-dns, IAM roles, RAM shares)

risk.means: blocker, open question, cost hotspot; use for chips and callouts, rarely for whole boxes

neutral.means: default card: a component with no special role

outside.means: outside the scope of the figure: clients, users, systems we only talk to

later.means: later phase, optional, proposed, or legacy

line_style.solid: exists now, or in scope for this phase
